piece: Read the Jira ticket and its acceptance criteria
Do not start work (branch) on a ticket without acceptance criteria
Always follow the same steps: branch, tests first, code, then PR
Derive the branch name from the ticket: type/KEY-123-short-title
The agent never merges its own PR
The agent cannot modify the files of .github/workflows/
No PR merges if its tests do not pass
Before opening the PR, a fresh look reviews the diff against the acceptance criteria
Decide how to split into commits
Comment on the Jira ticket with the link to the PR
Know that the project is in TypeScript, with pnpm
In migrations/, an existing migration is not modified: a new one is added
